LESSON: FICTION AND NON- FICTION 7.3.2 NON-FICTION: AUTOBIOGRAPHY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Fiction and Non- Fiction 7.3.2 non-fiction: Autobiography
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Fiction and Non- Fiction 7.3.2 non-fiction: Autobiography, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 LITERATURE IN ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: how they can be emulated. Learners 1. What lessons can be drawn from an autobiography? 2. How can one write an autobiography?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain the values depicted in an autobiography for lifelong learning,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Fiction and Non- Fiction 7.3.2 non-fiction: Autobiography in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. relate the autobiography to culture for lifelong learning,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Fiction and Non- Fiction 7.3.2 non-fiction: Autobiography in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. explain the values depicted in an autobiography for lifelong learning,

   Fiction and Non- Fiction 7.3.2 non-fiction: Autobiography helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. relate the autobiography to culture for lifelong learning,

   Fiction and Non- Fiction 7.3.2 non-fiction: Autobiography helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

● Creativity and imagination: This is enhanced as the learner links values in the autobiography to their own life.

● Self-efficacy: This is nurtured as the learner analyses and justifies their strengths and weaknesses while discussing and
